description: This source file defines the CapabilitiesClient class, responsible for interacting with a server to retrieve capabilities and user display name information, utilizing network API calls via Retrofit and managing related data.

classes.name: CapabilitiesClient
classes.description: A client class for fetching capabilities and user display name from a server in an Android context, using SSO accounts and Retrofit API calls.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the server capabilities via API, updates local repository, and returns the capabilities data.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Fetches the display name of a user associated with the provided SSO account.
